title: Cargo Recognition Mechanisms of Yeast Myo2 Revealed by AlphaFold2-Powered Protein Complex Prediction.
summary: Predictions for additional yeast cargo-adaptor complexes were supported by biochemical characterization; the result is basic cargo recognition, not a general biological engineering capability.
organization: Harbin Institute of Technology; Southern University of Science and Technology

evidence.tested: Predictions for additional yeast cargo-adaptor complexes were supported by biochemical characterization; admit basic cargo recognition, not a general biological engineering capability.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
